_about: Headlines for the App Store pictures made by frame_shots.py. One entry a picture, in store order: n is its number in the file name (final/<lang>/<n>-<name>.png), raw the AppStoreShots.swift shot it is made from (<lang>-<raw>.png), then the shots tried when that one is missing. title: at most 28 characters, benefit first (as in listing.md); sub: the smaller line under it. Uzbek Latin uses ‘ (U+2018) in o‘ and g‘.
